_about: The model families spark-hydra (spark-1 + spark-2) serves, and the engines it has, for scripts/backends/spark-model-intake.sh. DATA: read, never executed. docs/EXL3_PLAYBOOK.md explains every field. A family is one recipe + one image + one unit; a 'drop-in' for it is a checkpoint with the family's model_type, the family's required quantization fields and the same safetensors index KEY SET as the reference checkpoint (index_sha256 = sha256 of the sorted keys joined by newlines, with a trailing newline). Optional family fields: 'formats' (the checkpoint formats, in native TensorFold's capability vocabulary, the family serves; another format is not a drop-in), 'formats_not_servable' (format -> why that format of this model_type cannot be served on the pair: intake says NOT SERVABLE HERE with it), 'fit_note' (a measured or claimed resident size, shown beside the computed fit).
_measured: spark-1, 2026-11-17 (index signatures, sizes, rank files, MemTotal, native capabilities); read-only; hy4-vllm family and native 1.2.10: 2026-11-19 (the NVFP4 index from the Hub at 30f201ac; tensorfold capabilities --json and tensorfold info on spark-1, read-only)

pair.notes: MemTotal 127,598,412 kB on each Spark (MEASURED). The DeepSeek recipe runs 98.8 GiB of weights per rank (rank file 106,120,890,008 B) with ~6 GiB MemAvailable left on the head beside the command center: that is the tight end. GLM runs ~82 GiB per rank plus a 10 GiB KV pool. rank_weight_factor: per-rank bytes = checkpoint safetensors bytes / TP x factor, calibrated on DeepSeek (210,601,036,966 B checkpoint -> 106,120,890,008 B rank-1 file = 0.5039 of it).

families.title: Hy4-flash (atakann's NVFP4 build, vLLM TP2 + expert parallel)

formats_not_servable.exl3: Hy4-flash EXL3 is single-host only: ExLlamaV3's tensor-parallel workers are local processes on one host (model_tp.py, VERIFIED in docs/reviews/HY4_FLASH_ENGINES-2026-11-19.md), so it is NOT servable at TP2 across the pair, and no engine we have serves hy_v4_flash EXL3 at all (native TensorFold refuses hy_v4_flash). On ONE Spark it fits (an 84.87 GiB trunk, 118 GiB of Engram streamed from disk) but runs a pure-PyTorch reference attention with no server. The pack ~/Documents/LibertAIDAI-Hy4-flash-EXL3-4bpw is kept on purpose (Max, 2026-11-19). Serve Hy4 with the NVFP4 build instead: beast-spark hy4 (docs/EXL3_PLAYBOOK.md, case (c) worked example)
